The year, priced to its mood.

CHAPTER 03
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fiddle with single nights, define four broad seasons and let them carry the pricing forward. Override only where the calendar — an exhibition opening, a regional holiday, the long span of February — calls for it.

SEASONS
Four moods, plotted across the year.

●  Shoulder — Spring	Mar 1 — May 31	€295	2 nights	OPEN
●  High — Summer	Jun 1 — Sep 14	€385	3 nights	OPEN
●  Low — Deep Winter	Dec 20 — Jan 6	€345	4 nights	HOLDING

CHAPTER 04
Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outwards across all the channels you sell on. Hold rate to Airbnb, to the partner channels, to the studio's own ledger — all at the same time, all in service of one rhythm.
